query_analysis.original_query: In our solvent recovery system, azeotrope formation is limiting separation efficiency. Would azeotropic distillation or extractive distillation be a better solution?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Evaluate and recommend whether azeotropic distillation or extractive distillation would be more effective in overcoming azeotrope formation limiting separation efficiency in our solvent recovery system, aiming to enhance separation performance.

selected_agents.role: Evaluate separation methods and recommend optimal solution
Analyze azeotrope formation and phase behavior

communication_strategy.information_flow: Sharing of phase equilibrium data and separation process analyses
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Collaborative evaluation and selection of optimal distillation method

clarification_questions: What specific solvents are present in your recovery system, and which components are forming the azeotrope?
What are the operating conditions (temperature, pressure) of your current solvent recovery system?
Are there any constraints or preferences regarding the use of additional entrainers or solvents in your process?
